name: Edit_eval_benchmarks
description: A suite of benchmarks focused on evaluating edit and text‑revision capabilities of models, covering tasks such as targeted edits, rewriting, and post‑editing. It measures how well models can perform specified edits while preserving meaning and fluency. Evaluation typically compares model outputs to reference edits or human judgments.
reputation: A niche benchmark collection aimed at edit/evaluation tasks with limited but growing use in research focused on text editing and controllable generation.
